title: Auction Platform
details: Developed using ASP.NET Core, React, SignalR and SQL Server. Users can participate in live auctions with real-time price updates.

title: Machine Learning Dashboard
description: A dashboard that predicts sales using machine learning.
details: Developed a forecasting system using Python and SARIMA models to analyze sales trends and predict future performance.

title: Portfolio Website
details: A responsive portfolio website built using HTML, CSS and JavaScript with dynamically generated project cards.
